body.intent: The test suite is fast. Owner, 2026-11-14/15, after the orchestrator measured the suite (cold make test 854 s wall for 972 CPU-s on 4 cores, warm 254 s): a cold make test within 4 minutes and a warm one within 60 s on the 4-core VM, the median PR CI run within 3 minutes, with no test skipped and no coverage lost; five change sets, the gate bug first, projection out of scope.
body.title: Plan the fast test suite
